name: CeeDee Lamb

background.fact: Born April 8, 1999 in Opelousas, Louisiana; lived in New Orleans until his family evacuated to Houston, Texas after Hurricane Katrina in 2005.
background.confidence: from Wikipedia (data file bio lists birthplace Richmond, TX, which is his high school town)

background.fact: He got the nickname CeeDee in 4th grade when a coach could not pronounce his first name; at Foster High School in Richmond, Texas he had 98 catches for 2,032 yards and 33 touchdowns as a senior.
At Oklahoma he caught passes from Baker Mayfield and Kyler Murray and was a consensus All-American in 2019; Dallas picked him in the first round of the 2020 draft (17th overall per the data file).
background.confidence: from Wikipedia, pick number from the data file

background.fact: Pro Bowl in five of his first six seasons, All-Pro three times, and he led the NFL in receptions in 2023.
Listed at 6 ft 2 in, 198 lb, age 27, jersey 88, in his seventh NFL season, all with Dallas.

He signed a four-year, $136 million extension with Dallas in August 2024 with $100 million guaranteed and a $38 million signing bonus; he is under contract through 2028. Any later contract change: not found.

recent_events.fact: Cowboys beat the Colts 27-23 on Sunday, November 8 (Week 9); Lamb had 10 catches on 16 targets for 195 yards and a 44-yard touchdown before halftime, plus a lost fumble. George Pickens missed that game with a hamstring injury.

recent_events.fact: The 195 yards was a season high and the second best of his career (behind 227 against Detroit in 2023); the 10 catches put his career total at 641, an NFL record for most receptions before age 28, passing DeAndre Hopkins (632).

scouts_read: Lamb is healthy as far as public reporting shows and is the clear first option for Dak Prescott, with a 32.9 percent target share and a 195 yard game last week. Dallas hosts San Francisco in a high scoring projection (total 55.5), so passing volume should be good. Pickens returning will likely pull some looks away from the 16 targets Lamb got without him. His 2026 results are streaky, with two games under 6 points and three over 23, so I would not count on a steady number. I would project a solid game in the high teens to low 20s with a real chance of another big day.
